The Drum Hut website

The site uses Eleventy with the existing Handlebars templates and JSON data.

From this directory:

npm ci
npm run build

The build writes the static site to dist and uses clean directory URLs such as /djembes/ and /djembe-mandelbrot/. Run npm run server for a local development server, or npm run lint to check the JavaScript.

Build-time integrations read SNIPCART_PUBLIC_API_KEY and GTM_CONTAINER_ID from the environment. A local .env file can be created from .env.example.
